t: About the Oregon Office of Administrative Hearings (OAH)
s: In 1999, the Oregon Legislature created the Office of Administrative Hearings. Our role is to provide an independent and impartial forum for citizens and businesses to dispute state agency action against them. Prior to the creation of the OAH, contested case disputes were mostly handled internally by state agencies.
